module.label: Chat commands
module.description: Personalized viewer replies through the shared Hub sender.

flows.label: A viewer uses a chat command
flows.detail: One subscriber matches enabled commands and trusted roles. Aliases share cooldowns; duplicate/stale messages are rejected. The bounded Hub reply queue rechecks settings generation, channel and lifetime before sending. Private previews never enqueue messages.

steps.label: Match enabled command and permission
steps.detail: Only this channel, recent trusted message IDs and enabled command groups.

steps.label: Check alias-shared and per-viewer cooldowns
steps.detail: Bounded caches; failed admission consumes no cooldown.

steps.label: Queue a revision-guarded reply
steps.detail: The callback returns promptly; settings edits and shutdown revoke pending intent.

steps.label: Deliver through the Hub chat sender
steps.detail: One authorized, bounded Helix delivery worker. No second socket, credential store, or retry of uncertain writes.
